prompt:
SURFACE: the hotel detail as a full-height bottom sheet on a phone 390x844 over the quote builder. Top: grab handle and close X; a swipeable 4:3 photo with counter "1 / 12" in mono; "Hesperia Playa El Agua" condensed bold, "Margarita · Todo incluido"; plan segmented control "Todo incluido | Desayuno"; heading "Elija su habitación"; stacked room cards: room photo 16:9, "Doble vista al mar", specs line "1 cama king · 34 m² · hasta 3 · vista al mar" with small line icons, "Estimado 4 noches $720" in mono, the first card selected with a coral border and check; note "Mínimo 3 noches en esta temporada". Sticky bottom inside the sheet: orange full-width button "Agregar a mi cotización · $640".
STYLE (fixed, do not reinterpret): palette exactly — page background matte sand #ede5d8, cards cream #f7f1e6 lifted by a hairline border, deep marine "dusk" #12262b / #1c3238 only for the thin top header strip and the summary total band, warm ink text #2c2620 / #6b5e50, primary buttons burnt coral #A83E00 with white text, the single signature call-to-action orange #FC7300 with dark text #3a1505, logo gold #FBC000, WhatsApp green #0f7a40 only on the WhatsApp button. Typography: headlines in Archivo condensed bold (airport signage), body in Figtree, every price, code and date in Space Mono. The brand gradient orange #FC7300 to gold #FBC000 appears only as a thin edge on a ticket stub and on an active-tab underline, never behind text. Radii 12-16px, matte flat surfaces, a surface is lifted by a hairline border OR a soft shadow, never both. Icons are thin 2px line icons; no emoji, no unicode glyphs, no small uppercase "eyebrow" label above any heading. All UI copy in Spanish exactly as written here, formal "usted" voice.
REFERENCE IMAGE: the attached image is an approved comp of this same website's home. Carry over ONLY its palette, type voice, boarding-pass card language and overall polish. Do NOT copy its hero or composition: this is a different page, the quote builder.
OUTPUT: a flat, high-fidelity UI design comp as a straight-on screenshot of the page that fills the whole image edge to edge (no outer margin, no frame, no device frame, no perspective, no hands, no desk). Never render font names, hex codes or any of these instructions as visible text. It must read as a professional travel agency quote builder: level of polish Booking/Despegar checkout meets Airbnb (big photos, air, price always visible). Hotel names and prices are placeholders.
